test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper purchased 59 dozens of articles at the rate of ₹728 per dozen. He sold each one of them at the rate of ₹91. What percentage profit did he make?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) per dozen = ₹728

Quantity = 59 dozens

Selling Price (SP) per article = ₹91

**Formula used:**

Total CP = Dozens × Price per dozen

Total SP = Total articles × Price per article

Profit % = ((SP − CP) ÷ CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total articles = 59 × 12 = 708

Total CP = 59 × 728 = ₹42,952

Total SP = 708 × 91 = ₹64,428

Profit = 64428 − 42952 = ₹21,476

Profit % = (21476 ÷ 42952) × 100 = 50%

**∴ Profit percentage = 50%**
